title: Revenue YTD
description: Revenue (NII + fees) booked this calendar year for the selected client, compared with the same months last year.

custom.cypher:
WITH datetime.truncate('year', datetime($asOfDate)) AS yearStart, datetime.truncate('month', datetime($asOfDate)) AS monthStart
MATCH (r:RevenueMonth)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(:Client {clientId: $clientId})
RETURN sum(CASE WHEN r.month >= yearStart THEN r.totalUsd ELSE 0 END) AS revenueYtdUsd,
       sum(CASE WHEN r.month >= yearStart - duration({years: 1}) AND r.month < monthStart - duration({years: 1}) THEN r.totalUsd ELSE 0 END) AS revenuePriorYtdUsd
